Preserve every original SVG. Do not redraw or retype the logo wordmark.
Orange or black on light backgrounds; white on dark backgrounds.
Proposed clear space: at least ¼ of mascot height. Keep original proportions.
Use full logo at entry points; compact mascot in app chrome.
Google Sans for UI only. Khmer first; generous line height and wrapping labels.
48px minimum touch targets · 16px screen padding · 12px between cards.
Inputs 12px corners · Cards 16px · Sheets 24px · Status pills fully rounded.
